Guan Yu twists at waist and unleashes his colossal jade crescent blade DOWNWARD-FORWARD toward the giant gate-lock/barrier below-right. A very tiny covered escort cart and two tiny travelers on a safe distant stretch suggest protected traveling companions. Void violet below, cosmic blue cloud sea, amber god-light shaft at far horizon. Graphic huge silhouettes, smooth sculpted manga face and armor planes, billowing green cloth in controlled large ribbons, extreme perspective. Gold stage more triumphant and visually commanding than silver, martial saint traversing realms, not realistic film still or flat cartoon. No text or logos.
